reply_text: Sofia, I replied in #coastal-team, in the thread on your message: Pellucid Harbor Logistics belongs to Kwame Adjei-Rowe, who took over the account from Bettina on November 22, 2025. Bettina confirmed on October 14 that it stays with Kwame, so PHL tickets for Pellucid should go to him. I also noted that Pellow Home Living is the Mid-Atlantic account, which is the one Bettina is covering next week.
